status: DECLARED BEFORE ANY RUN of this metric. No value of OSI has been computed at declaration time.
why_new_hypothesis: seq 120162 withdrew the previous claim: null A (order destroyed) reproduced the observed 18/36 and null B (size matched) erased it (0/36). Δσ is blind to order and confounded by length, so it cannot test 'this corpus is special'. This prereg defines an order-sensitive metric and a construct-validity gate instead of reusing the withdrawn one.

metric.name: OSI - order sensitivity index
metric.sentences: >256 tokens dropped and counted; count published per corpus
metric.windows: 50 consecutive sentences, stride 25, only full windows
metric.d_real: mean cosine distance between consecutive sentence embeddings inside a window
metric.d_local: same, after shuffling sentences inside the same window (order destroyed, token composition preserved), seed 20261112
metric.OSI: (d_local - d_real) / d_local per window; corpus value = mean over windows; 0 means no order structure
metric.length_policy: each corpus cut to exactly 150000 tokens (word tokenizer, lowercase, unicode NFKC) BEFORE any metric computation; cut position published; corpora shorter than 150000 tokens are reported but excluded from the ranking

construct_validity_gate.run_order: gate first, corpora second, one process
construct_validity_gate.positive_control: S_struct = Markov-2 text generated from the token distribution of corpus/news.txt; S_null = the same token multiset shuffled globally
construct_validity_gate.pass_rule: OSI(S_struct) - OSI(S_null) >= 0.05 and their 95% bootstrap CIs do not overlap
construct_validity_gate.on_fail: metric rejected in public; no corpus claim is made; the previous claim stays withdrawn; a new attempt requires a new prereg with a new date

nulls.A_global_token_shuffle: same token multiset, order and segmentation destroyed; 12 replicates
nulls.B_size_matched: all corpora cut to the same declared 150000 tokens (not to the minimum observed)
nulls.C_label_permutation: labels permuted across corpora, 20000 simulations, seed 20261112

corpora.policy: fixed at declaration, six Gutenberg texts, inconvenient ones included; no additions or removals after the run

analysis.blind: one run, no intermediate inspection, no threshold edits
analysis.report: full table: per-corpus OSI, 95% bootstrap CI (1000 resamples over windows), n windows, n dropped sentences, plus null A/B/C results
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across the five comparisons against urantia

claim_allowed_if: OSI 95% CI for urantia strictly below all five others
run reproduced by an independent party from the published code
decision_rule.claim_denied_if: any of the above fails - the post is a withdrawal, no reinterpretation, no 'but on average'
